title: Experiences with similar dreams
content: Not a mallworld guy but all of your stories intrigue me deeply as someone who has had my own weird experiences with dreaming. A lot of these were more common as a young kid, my recurring dreams, out of body experiences, & lucid dreams. I had a place I’d visit every night from the ages of 2-4, it’s so vivid it feels like a memory. It was a pink castle, with a purple roof. Most of my dreams consisted of me taking the same exact path to reach this castle every single night. The dream was somewhat of a lucid dream, I was capable of easily taking control of whatever dreams I was in at that age. I’d always be conscious that I was there, and I’d be sure to always follow the same path. The place itself was pretty uneventful, I wasn’t able to travel past the front of the castle ever. I don’t remember when it started or why, but I would constantly recount my dreams to my family the next day. It always freaked me out (and still continues to) how my dreams wound up happening shot for shot in real life, either to me or a random scenario happening in the news. It’s usually pretty horrifying stuff which is what freaks me out so bad.
